        self.val = val
        self.next = next

class ListNode:

        self.val = val
        self.next = next

def reverse_list(head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
    # Initialize previous pointer to None
    prev = None
    
    # Traverse through the list until we reach the end
    while head is not None:
        # Store the next node
        next_node = head.next

This function iterates through the linked list, reversing the direction of each node's pointer from pointing to the next node to pointing to the previous node. The process continues until the end of the list is reached, at which point `prev` will be pointing to the new head of the reversed list.
